en: Vintage New Year greeting postcard dated 1896. The top shows the text 'Godt nytt År!' and 'Onnellista Uutta Vuotta' with spruce branches and cones. Below is an industrial‑commercial scene by the waterfront at sunset: men working on a roof with rolls of roofing material, barrels, crates, a basket with a bottle, grapes and a wine cask. In the background is a distant city skyline across water. At the bottom is a decorative ribbon bearing the name 'J. E. Cronvall' and the bilingual city name 'Helsingfors – Helsinki'.
